modelNotes: Points Board 1.4 reads from core, minutes, usage, opponent team defense, and opponent pace data.
Opponent points defense and pace apply a transparent adjustment capped at plus or minus 6 percent.
Expected minutes, rest, verified teammate absences, and recent-game volatility produce opportunity adjustments and projection ranges.

Foundation uses scoring average, last 5 form, last 10 form, enhanced expected minutes, minutes confidence, minutes trend, usage score, usage trend, volume acceleration, shot volume trend, free throw volume trend, and starter status.
No odds or betting lines are used.

injury.shortComment: Irving (knee) is questionable to play in Sunday's game against the Celtics.
injury.detail: Irving poured in a game-high 34 points in 37 minutes during Saturday's 127-117 loss to Cleveland, so there's a decent chance Dallas will give their star point guard the night off for the second leg of their back-to-back set. If he is indeed out, Cooper Flagg's usage would see a massive boost while Naji Marshall and Walter Clayton Jr. figure to earn more minutes off the bench.

injury.shortComment: Mitchell (ankle) is questionable to suit up for Sunday's game against the Kings.
injury.detail: Mitchell has missed OKC's previous two contests due to a sprained left ankle, and he's now in jeopardy of sitting out a third straight. If Mitchell remains sidelined, Jared McCain will continue to start for the 8-5 Thunder.

injury.shortComment: Johnson is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Rockets due to lower-back soreness.
injury.detail: Johnson has logged at least 27 minutes in each of Washington's last five games, but a back injury could prevent him from facing Houston on Sunday. If he and Bub Carrington (chest) are both ruled out, Will Riley could play meaningful minutes against the Rockets.

injury.shortComment: Rollins (illness) is questionable to play in Sunday's game against the Hawks.
injury.detail: Rollins played 30 minutes off Milwaukee's bench during Friday's 107-99 loss to Orlando, but an illness has put his status for Sunday up in the air. If he can't play, expect Gary Trent Jr., AJ Green and Kasparas Jakucionis to see additional minutes.

injury.shortComment: Achiuwa (ankle) is questionable for Sunday's game against the Thunder.
injury.detail: Achiuwa missed Friday's 120-107 loss to Portland due to left ankle soreness, and that same ailment will keep him questionable for Sunday's home tilt against OKC. Keegan Murray got the start in place of Achiuwa, which would likely be the case again if the latter is sidelined.

injury.shortComment: Gafford (shoulder) is probable to play in Sunday's game against the Celtics.
injury.detail: Gafford took an elbow to the shoulder during Saturday's 127-117 loss in Cleveland and eventually left and did not return to the contest. It's a good sign for Dallas that he's listed as probable, so all signs point to Gafford being in the lineup versus Boston.

injury.shortComment: Aldama (ankle) is listed as questionable for Sunday's game in Boston.
injury.detail: Aldama had 12 points, two rebounds and one steal in Saturday's 130-93 win over Brooklyn. He's in jeopardy of missing this contest, though it wouldn't be surprising if he didn't play, considering Sunday's game marks the second of a back-to-back for the Mavs. If Aldama can't suit up, Morez Johnson could be in line for more minutes.

injury.shortComment: Smart has been suspended three games for throwing a punch during Wednesday's matchup against Golden State, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.
injury.detail: Smart, who was ejected from Wednesday's game for punching Charles Bassey, will begin serving his suspension Friday night against the Jazz, meaning he'll be eligible to return Wednesday versus Indiana. Bruce Thornton and Reed Sheppard should be in line for more minutes while Smart serves his three-game ban.

injury.shortComment: Landale (hip) is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against Milwakee.
injury.detail: After being listed as available, Landale was downgraded and is in danger of missing Sunday's meeting with Milwaukee. If that happens, Zuby Ejiofor could see more minutes behind Onyeka Okongwu.

injury.shortComment: Christie (ankle) is doubtful to play Sunday's game against the Celtics.
injury.detail: A sprained left ankle forced Christie to miss Saturday's 127-117 loss to Cleveland, and he's in serious danger of missing a second consecutive outing with the ailment. If Christie sits again, Naji Marshall, Zaccharie Risacher and Walter Clayton Jr. will divvy up the vacated minutes.
